title: Berawa Beach Sunrise Cleanup
summary: Two hours on the sand before the heat arrives. Bags, gloves and sorting bins provided — bring water and a hat.
preparationNotes: Closed shoes — there is glass in the tideline
Reusable water bottle, refill station on site
Sun cover; there is no shade on the beach

title: Mangrove Planting — Benoa Bay
summary: Planting propagules along the restored channel edge. Muddy, slow, genuinely effective work.
address: Jl. By Pass Ngurah Rai, Pemogan, Denpasar Selatan
preparationNotes: Clothes you are happy to ruin
Sandals with a heel strap, not flip-flops
A towel and a change of clothes for afterwards

title: Tukad Badung River Clearing
summary: Clearing plastic from the river margin before the rains push it out to sea.
preparationNotes: Gloves provided, but bring your own if you have them

title: Coral Fragment Planting — Nusa Dua
summary: Attaching nursery-grown fragments to the restoration frames. Open-water certification required.
address: Jl. Nusa Dua, Benoa, Kuta Selatan
preparationNotes: Open Water certification card required at check-in
Tanks and weights provided; bring your own mask if you prefer
No gloves — hands only, to protect the fragments

title: Composting Workshop for Households
summary: Build a working bokashi bucket you take home. Covers what to feed it and how not to make it smell.
preparationNotes: You will leave carrying a 15-litre bucket — plan your transport

title: Turtle Hatchling Release — Kuta
summary: Evening release of the season's last hatchlings, with a short briefing on nest protection.
preparationNotes: No flash photography — it disorients the hatchlings
Arrive 15 minutes early for the briefing

title: Neighbourhood Waste Sorting Drive
summary: Sorting a week of collected household waste into organic, recyclable and residual streams.
preparationNotes: Bring your own household recyclables if you have them
